Manifest.Name: 原版化学扩展 / Vanilla Chemistry Expansion
Manifest.Author: gdm56
Manifest.Description: 以原版化学系统为基础的扩展。梦魔菌毒素：梦帽菇和梦魇帽菇萃取液 1:1 混合，在 0.5–5% 酸度下冷藏生成，压制成合法医美注射剂，只有药用级以上才值钱；步骤收录在进阶化学手册里，退休化学家和杰克逊博士出售。矿石化学：金属矿石可在装满 4 个化学模组的搅拌机里搅碎，制取生石灰和硅胶，用来去除酸碱里滤不掉的化学污染物和重金属，帮助药品做到实验室纯。另有淀粉基因、工业酒精（水解、酵母过夜发酵、冷冻浓缩）、勾兑葡萄酒（品质、双标签与欺诈机制）、啤酒（桶装、罐装、扎啤，分三档品质）、高级韧棉织物，核废料后处理（撬开核废料、萃取钚做成钚安瓿、玻璃固化裂变产物，小心辐射病）、空心灯（实验室辣椒，提纯成合法的失能剂，卖给上层区和治安部能冲减罪名和调查进度），以及电解食盐水（订购盐矿，电解出碱、氢气和氯气，合成氯化氢再溶成盐酸，批量自制纯净的酸碱）。 /An expansion built on the vanilla chemistry system. Dream Toxin: mix Dream Cap and Nightmare Cap extracts 1:1 with 0.5-5% acid and refrigerate to form it, then press legal cosmetic injectors that only sell at pharma grade or better; the steps are in the Advanced Chemistry Handbook sold by the retired chemist and Dr. Jackson. Ore chemistry: crush metal ore in a blender with all 4 chem modules to make quicklime and silica gel, which remove the unfilterable chemical contaminant and heavy metal from acid and base so drugs can reach lab-pure grade. Also adds starch genes, industrial alcohol (hydrolysis, overnight yeast fermentation, freeze concentration), blended wine with quality, two labels and fraud rules, beer (kegs, cans and draft beer in three quality tiers), an advanced Kotton fabric, nuclear waste reprocessing (pry open nuclear waste, extract plutonium into ampoules, vitrify the fission products, beware radiation sickness), and Hollow's Lantern (a lab-bred chili refined into a legal incapacitant that lowers your crimes and investigation progress when sold to the Upper Level or Security), and brine electrolysis (order rock salt, electrolyse it into base, hydrogen and chlorine, burn the gases into hydrogen chloride and dissolve it into acid, for pure acid and base in bulk).
